changelog:
## v1.9.29

- NEW: Unified All-in-One 'Bundle Smart Checkout' Elementor Widget (wcsc_bundle_checkout)
  - Multi-product bundle grid with selection states
  - Inline variation buttons for variable products directly on product cards
  - Tiered quantity discounts with real-time dynamic summary bar
  - Integrated Order Bump section with 1-click toggle
  - Complete native WooCommerce checkout form with AJAX order placement
- Existing 'Product Variation & Checkout' and 'Thank You' widgets remain completely untouched and backward-compatible
- Linux/cPanel POSIX ZIP standard package
